package http_test

import (
 . "net/http"
 "net/http/httptest"
 "testing"
)

type testMode string
const (
 http1Mode testMode="h1"
 http2Mode testMode="h2"
)

type clientServerTest struct {
 ts *httptest.Server
 tr *Transport
 c *Client
}

func (c *clientServerTest) close() {
 c.tr.CloseIdleConnections()
 c.ts.Close()
}

func setParallel(t *testing.T) {
 if testing.Short() { t.Parallel() }
}

// The selected upstream tests require real HTTP/1 and TLS HTTP/2 servers.
// This adapter omits upstream facilities for HTTP/3 and fake network internals.
func newClientServerTest(t *testing.T,mode testMode,h Handler,opts ...any) *clientServerTest {
 ts:=httptest.NewUnstartedServer(h)
 if mode==http2Mode { ts.EnableHTTP2=true;ts.StartTLS() } else { ts.Start() }
 c:=ts.Client()
 tr:=c.Transport.(*Transport)
 for _,opt:=range opts { opt.(func(*Transport))(tr) }
 cst:=&clientServerTest{ts:ts,tr:tr,c:c}
 t.Cleanup(cst.close)
 return cst
}

var http3SkippedMode=[]testMode{http1Mode,http2Mode}

func run(t *testing.T,f func(*testing.T,testMode),opts ...any) {
 modes:=http3SkippedMode
 if len(opts)>0 {modes=opts[0].([]testMode)}
 for _,mode:=range modes {
  t.Run(string(mode),func(t *testing.T) { t.Cleanup(func() { afterTest(t) }); f(t,mode) })
 }
}
